_doc: Which NPC casters join which squads (scripts/combat/caster_spawns.gd). per = one caster per this many soldiers (rounded down), max = cap per squad, min_count = the squad must be at least this big, chance = roll per squad. Casters are also capped world-wide (NpcCaster.MAX_ACTIVE) and by the patrol limits in scripts/world/path_patrols.gd, so these mixes stay cheap.
